schrijven.pattern: The root concerns putting language or information into written form. Prefixes add direction, repetition, registration, transfer, or attribution.
schrijven.memoryHook: Picture information moving onto paper or into a record; the prefix tells you what happens to it.

lezen.pattern: The root concerns extracting meaning from text, symbols, or data. Prefixes add completion, repetition, checking, or reading aloud.
lezen.memoryHook: Imagine your eyes moving through a text; the prefix tells you how or why you read it.

zien.pattern: The root covers visual perception and figurative understanding. Prefixes add inspection, realization, anticipation, or looking back.
zien.memoryHook: Start with seeing; then let the prefix tell you the direction of attention.

horen.pattern: The root concerns sound, listening, and in some forms belonging. Prefixes add testing, questioning, or intensive listening.
horen.memoryHook: Think of sound reaching you; the prefix changes whether you listen, test, or question.

zoeken.pattern: The root expresses looking for information, people, objects, or solutions. Prefixes add depth, direction, verification, or formal requesting.
zoeken.memoryHook: Picture yourself searching; the prefix tells you where and how thoroughly.

kiezen.pattern: The root expresses selection between alternatives. Prefixes add preference, preselection, repetition, or special appointment.
kiezen.memoryHook: Imagine several options in front of you; the prefix tells you how the choice is made.

sluiten.pattern: The root concerns closing, joining, or reaching a conclusion. Prefixes add connection, exclusion, enclosure, or completion.
sluiten.memoryHook: Think of two sides coming together; the prefix shows what is closed, joined, or excluded.

leiden.pattern: The root concerns guiding people, processes, or attention. Prefixes add introduction, training, diversion, or deduction.
leiden.memoryHook: Picture a route with someone guiding it; the prefix tells you where the route goes.

bouwen.pattern: The root concerns creating structures or gradually developing systems. Prefixes add expansion, conversion, completion, or reconstruction.
bouwen.memoryHook: Imagine blocks being added; the prefix shows whether you build up, out, again, or differently.

groeien.pattern: The root expresses increase, maturation, or development over time. Prefixes add continuation, adaptation, return, or completion.
groeien.memoryHook: Picture something becoming larger or more mature; the prefix shows the direction of growth.

draaien.pattern: The root concerns rotation, operation, or a change of direction. Prefixes add tightening, reversal, continuation, or outcome.
draaien.memoryHook: Imagine a wheel turning; the prefix tells you how or where it turns.

wijzen.pattern: The root concerns pointing, showing, or directing attention. Prefixes add rejection, allocation, proof, or referral.
wijzen.memoryHook: Picture a finger pointing; the prefix tells you what is being indicated or decided.

delen.pattern: The root concerns splitting something into parts or sharing information and resources. Prefixes add allocation, subdivision, or redistribution.
delen.memoryHook: Imagine one whole becoming several parts; the prefix tells you how those parts are handled.

richten.pattern: The root concerns aiming, arranging, or setting something up. Prefixes add creation, furnishing, performance, or causing an effect.
richten.memoryHook: Picture an arrow being aimed; the prefix tells you what is directed or established.

voeren.coreMeaning: to conduct, carry, feed, or transport
voeren.pattern: The root concerns carrying something forward: a conversation, policy, person, material, or process. Prefixes add entry, removal, implementation, or transport.
voeren.memoryHook: Imagine moving something through a process; the prefix tells you where it enters or leaves.

pakken.pattern: The root concerns taking hold of something physically or figuratively. Prefixes add tackling, removing, packing, resuming, or outcome.
pakken.memoryHook: Picture your hand taking hold; the prefix tells you what kind of action follows.
